Module com.example.batallanaval
Package com.example.batallanaval.view

Class ViewManager

java.lang.Object
com.example.batallanaval.view.ViewManager
public final class ViewManager extends Object
Centralized manager responsible for loading FXML views and swapping scenes on the primary stage. It is the single point of contact with the JavaFX Stage.

Follows the Singleton pattern (a supporting pattern; the project's primary declared pattern is the Factory used to create ships).
